title: Will Atherton
description: Padilla said, “we need to continue to dismantle racism particularly when it comes to gender identity.”
body:
# Will Atherton

# Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/atherton-profile.png)

- Supports **[school board policies](https://indyweek.com/news/politics/elections/candidate-questionnaire-will-atherton-orange-county-schools/)** mentioned under the district section that allows staff to discuss gender identity with students without parental consent. The policies also do “not require employees to notify parents that their children have presented as transgender, non-binary, or gender non-conforming.”
- Told the media he **[would not support](https://indyweek.com/news/politics/elections/candidate-questionnaire-will-atherton-orange-county-schools/)** a state bill that banned critical race theory in schools.
- Supported **[keeping](https://chapelboro.com/news/pre-k-12-education/orange-county-school-board-unanimously-keeps-challenged-books-in-libraries)** pornographic books in schools such as *Gender Queer* that depicts sexual acts.
